### NeuKRAG: Neuromorphic KG-RAG with Small LLMs for Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design
**Kannan, R., Gautam, A., Patton, R. M., Haas, N. D., Thomas, T., Aimone, J. B., Potok, T. E.**
Oak Ridge National Laboratory & Sandia National Laboratories. *Neuro Inspired Computational Elements, NICE 2026, Atlanta, GA, USA, March 24-26, 2026. IEEE, pp. 1-9.*

Scalable pipeline for constructing scientific knowledge graphs from neuromorphic literature with open LLMs, and a GraphRAG query layer combining vector search and k-hop graph traversal. 2,396 documents, 921,545 triples, 100% query completion.

[Download PDF](papers/neukrag-nice2026.pdf) - [DOI: 10.1109/NICE69539.2026.11567520](https://doi.org/10.1109/NICE69539.2026.11567520)
:::

::: {.thread-card}
### Cross-Domain Reasoning for Neuromorphic Model Design
**Ramavarapu, V., Johnson-Scott, Z., Gautam, A., Kannan, R.**
*Proceedings of the 16th ACM International Green and Sustainable Computing Conference, IGSC 2026, CanandaiguaUSA, June 22-24, 2026. ACM, pp. 97-102.*

Introduces a multi-corpus knowledge graph spanning neuroscience, traditional machine learning, and neuromorphic computing, and NeuKReAct, an agentic reasoning framework that iteratively retrieves from the graph and synthesizes neuromorphic model design hypotheses via a step-by-step blackboard architecture, plus an execution head that translates hypotheses into structured design documents and runnable code.

[DOI: 10.1145/3797248.3816054](https://doi.org/10.1145/3797248.3816054)
:::

::: {.thread-card}
### Neuromorphic Codesign Agent: Multimodal Knowledge Graph Construction and KG-Grounded Constrained Generation for Neuromorphic Research Automation
**Research Team**
Oak Ridge National Laboratory, with Virginia Tech collaborators. *Manuscript in preparation.*

A two-phase system automating neuromorphic research workflows via a multimodal KG (concepts, LaTeX formulas, validated Python code, validated SPICE netlists) built from 5,999 PDFs, plus an interactive Streamlit application for KG-grounded hypothesis generation and constrained code/circuit synthesis.

*PDF forthcoming.*
:::
